descriptionByLocale.en:
This is a unique opportunity to be on the ground floor as “Wall St. South” develops in South Florida. We're looking for an Institutional Equity Sales Coverage professional to:
• provide day-to-day equities and research sales coverage for South Florida institutional clients, staying close to each client’s investment process and priorities
• translate UBS research, market moves, and actionable themes into timely, high-conviction client dialogue and trade ideas
• coordinate access to UBS analysts, strategists, economists, and corporate access to deliver the right expertise at the right time
• deepen relationships with priority accounts and grow share of client activity through consistent coverage, disciplined follow-up, and high service standards
• execute a high-touch, in-person coverage cadence across the region, including frequent client meetings, support for visits/events, and strong internal coordination across Global Markets
